_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
name: oto-factory
summary: The software factory on an OTO graph: a runner that builds a component inside its write scope, an evaluator that judges the result without the runner's reasoning, an aggregator that gathers verdicts, two hooks that enforce the scope and run the loop to an iteration cap, and the factory-run ontology with the engine-side commands (spec, plan, scope, criteria, the run graph, deviations, metrics). A use case of the graph, in its own repository (ADR-0007).

changelog.note: Its own repository, Cynergis/oto-factory (ADR-0007): the plugin and the factory-run pack with its code, listed in the registry, installed whole; the engine's repository forgets it. Needs an engine that loads a pack's code/ (built from main after 2026-10-28, or 0.14.2 and later).

Pinned to the engine release that loads a pack's code/: engine >=0.14.2 (released 2026-10-28). CI installs the engine at v0.14.2 instead of main; the Actions workflow installs it at the tag too and takes the plugins from the registry, Cynergis/oto-registry (the engine's own marketplace no longer carries the factory). Nothing changes in the plugin or the ontology.
